name: QSpace
price: One-time: QSpace (MAS) $12.99, QSpace Pro (direct) $13.99 sale price (list $27.99/$29.99); paid extensions: Stash Shelf, Advanced Batch Rename, Server Connections ($0.99-$9.99), Enhanced Archiver (free promo, list $4.99)
summary: Finder-like multi-pane file manager with 12 layouts, workspaces, heavy customization (hotkeys, context menu, colors) and regex search. Paid extensions add archive browsing, server/cloud connections and advanced batch rename.
where_it_wins: Up to 12 pane layouts and saved workspaces
Deep customization of hotkeys, context menus, toolbar, colors
Folder sync, file hashes, file templates
Quick image actions (rotate, convert, remove background)
Video metadata columns (frame rate, data rate)
where_schnellbild_wins: Free, no paid extensions; archives included
Real image/video viewer with slideshow and full-size paging
Videos and comics straight from archives
No account, never online, open source

free.note: One-time: MAS $12.99 or Pro $13.99 (sale prices; list $27.99/$29.99), extensions $0.99-$9.99 each; Pro has 30-day trial

no_account_no_tracking.note: Pro license is tied to an account (2 devices); App Store label: Identifiers linked to you

dark_light_setting.note: Custom color schemes with light/dark modes (beta 7.0.4); separate app appearance switch not documented

languages_20.note: About 14 languages (EN, ZH-Hans/Hant, NL, FR, DE, HU, IT, JA, KO, PL, RU, ES, TR)

thumbnail_grid.note: Icon view with thumbnails, folder perspective thumbnails; Gallery view in 7.0.4 beta

list_view.note: List view with many columns incl. frame rate and data rate

recursive_search.note: Pane search with 'Search in subfolders', plus Spotlight search

regex_search.note: Pane search: keywords, wildcard or regular expression

network_shares_fast.note: Option to reduce metadata reads on network volumes (on by default)

multiple_windows.note: Windows as workspaces, tabs, 12 pane layouts

img_modern_formats.note: Side preview/Quick Look with macOS codecs; only HEIC named (folder thumbnails); AVIF/JXL/WebP not mentioned

img_raw.note: Would depend on macOS Quick Look/ImageIO; RAW not mentioned. Searched user guide, changelog, App Store page

img_psd_exr.note: Would depend on macOS Quick Look/ImageIO; PSD/EXR not mentioned. Searched user guide, changelog, App Store page

img_svg_pdf.note: Side preview and Quick Look show PDF and SVG (SVG dimensions, PDF tools in changelog)

img_animated.note: Would depend on macOS Quick Look (plays GIF); QSpace docs do not mention animated images. Searched user guide, changelog

keyboard_paging.note: Quick Look and side preview follow the (marked) item while navigating

zoom_rotate.note: Quick Look zoom; Rotate action changes the file

slideshow.note: Context menu 'Instant SlideShow' (macOS Quick Look full screen)

slideshow_recursive.note: 'Instant SlideShow' runs on the selection; whether it works on subfolder search results is not documented. Searched user guide and changelog

auto_enhance_view.note: No such feature in the user guide, the App Store description or the full changelog; image actions (rotate, flip, convert) change the file

file_info_exif.note: Get Info/side preview show video frame rate, data rate, duration

wrong_extension_note.note: No such feature in the user guide, the App Store description or the full changelog

video_mkv_avi_webm.note: Preview relies on macOS media extensions for formats like MKV (changelog fix for 'videos requiring media extensions')

photos_videos_one_grid.note: Icon/Gallery views show all file types

video_skim_arrows.note: Arrow keys move the selection (Quick Look/side preview follow it), not through the video

subtitles_embedded.note: Not mentioned; subtitle menu of the macOS Quick Look player not documented. Searched user guide, changelog, App Store page

subtitles_external_files.note: Media plays only in the side preview or the macOS Quick Look window; the full changelog has no player settings

audio_track_choice.note: Not mentioned; track menu of the macOS Quick Look player not documented. Searched user guide, changelog, App Store page

playback_speed.note: Media plays only in the side preview or the macOS Quick Look window; the full changelog has no player settings

control_bar_movable.note: Media plays only in the side preview or the macOS Quick Look window; the full changelog has no player settings

playlist.note: No such feature in the user guide, the App Store description or the full changelog

saved_playlists.note: No such feature in the user guide, the App Store description or the full changelog

pip.note: Media plays only in the side preview or the macOS Quick Look window; the full changelog has no player settings

music_mode.note: Audio cover thumbnails and Quick Look playback only

streaming_urls.note: No such feature in the user guide, the App Store description or the full changelog (Server Connections browse files, no streaming URLs)

online_subtitles.note: No such feature in the user guide, the App Store description or the full changelog

video_filters_enhance.note: Media plays only in the side preview or the macOS Quick Look window; the full changelog has no player settings; only rotate/flip MOV/MP4 as a file action

quicklook_mkv_thumbnails.note: Uses the system's Quick Look and media extensions; installs no Quick Look generator of its own

archives_as_folders.note: Enhanced Archiver extension (listed 'Free', regular $4.99): browse RAR, ZIP, 7z, TAR … as folders, nested too

comics_cbz_cbr.note: No comic reader; archive extension list is customizable, so CBZ/CBR could be browsed as archives

split_archives.note: Creates split volumes (extension); extraction of split sets not stated

videos_in_archives.note: 'Preview in QSpace' option for archives; no player

manga_two_page.note: No such feature in the user guide, the App Store description or the full changelog

move_copy.note: Copy/Move to Pane, drag and drop

dual_pane.note: Up to 12 multi-pane layouts; Copy/Move to Pane via custom hotkeys (no F5/F6 defaults stated); Windows key bindings option

image_editing.note: Quick actions: rotate, convert image, remove background, create PDF

batch_convert.note: Convert images; Advanced Batch Rename is a paid extension

cloud_sync.note: Server Connections extension: FTP, SFTP, Dropbox, OneDrive, Google Drive, S3 …

keyboard_first.note: Nearly every action can get a hotkey

custom_shortcuts.note: Custom hotkeys in both MAS and Pro

shortcut_cheatsheet.note: Hotkeys page explains assigning hotkeys but lists no keys; no printable sheet

boss_key.note: No such feature in the user guide, the App Store description or the full changelog

app_sandbox.note: MAS version is sandboxed (folders must be added manually); Pro version uses Full Disk Access

notarized_attested.note: Closed source (SHA256 of the DMG published)
